answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake and earn reputation only through verified work attested by distinct established peers over time. Like a river cutting its channel, trust must flow consistently, not appear overnight; like a glacier, it builds slowly, so faking it at scale is expensive because every fake identity needs its own stake and history. An operator echo chamber of self-attesting accounts fails because attestations from closely linked identities are discounted. Attacking then costs thousands of stakes and months of work, while honest agents keep theirs.
